label: Bible Study
prompt: Therefore they that were _____ abroad went every where preaching the word.
verse: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
note: Persecution scattered the church — and the scattered church preached everywhere it landed.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good _____: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
verse: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
note: Instead of scolding her for touching Him in the crowd, Jesus gave her a new name — Daughter — and good comfort.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Judah is a lion's _____: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
verse: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
note: Jacob's blessing calls Judah a lion's whelp — and Revelation 5:5 later hails 'the Lion of the tribe of Juda.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD _____ up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verse: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
note: Cyrus's decree freed the exiles to go home and rebuild — fulfilling what God had spoken through Jeremiah.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the _____ is.
verse: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.
note: After Goliath fell, Saul asked whose son 'the stripling' was — a lad barely grown, suddenly Israel's hero.
